controller_actions.task: Write module.py and test_cases.json per the user contract. module.py: solve(data) where data must be a dict with 'base' and 'patch' both dicts, else raise ValueError. Deep merge patch into base without mutating inputs (deepcopy results). For each patch key: value None -> remove key from result (no-op if absent); base key absent -> insert patch value as is (deep copied); both dicts -> recurse; both lists -> patch list replaces; different JSON types -> raise ValueError. Same type means both dict, both list, both str, both bool, or both number (int/float); bool and number are different types (bool is subclass of int in Python, handle explicitly). Result key order: base keys in original order, then patch-only keys in patch order. Removed keys are dropped. Note a None patch value for an absent key is a no-op (do not insert). Base value of None with non-null patch: types differ (null vs other) -> ValueError. Use only the standard library, no I/O. test_cases.json: JSON list of at least 8 distinct cases, each with input and exactly one of output or error (exception class name, e.g. ValueError). Cover: nested merge, list replacement, null removal, null on absent key, type mismatch error, bool vs number error, non-dict inputs error, key order, insertion as-is, no mutation. Expectations must match the contract exactly.
